summary: Jenkinsfile.iac-on-push now runs a Lint stage (terraform fmt -check, yamllint, strict ansible-lint, whose unskippable syntax-check rule covers all 14 playbooks) and a Terraform validate stage (init -backend=false + validate on prd and scratch) before the unchanged plan stage; iac-apply untouched. Gate scripts witnessed green in a fresh depth-1 clone under dash and red on fmt and syntax breakage (Ansible 652e1a5); close-out N1 records an accidental vault-password print in the session.
